admin.intro: Choose which links sit in the header, which stay in the forum's menu and which are hidden, rename them, change their icons, drag them into order and add links of your own. The editor opens on the forum itself, because that is where the forum's menu lives.

editor.title: Navigation
editor.intro: Everything your forum's menu offers is listed here. Drag a row to change the order, rename it, give it a different icon, and choose where it goes. The order applies to the header and to the menu alike.
editor.denied: Only administrators can edit the navigation.
editor.place_header_help: — a link in the header, and taken out of the menu.
editor.place_menu_help: — stays in the forum's menu (the sidebar, or your theme's pills or tiles).
editor.label: Name
editor.url_invalid: Use a path on this forum (starting with /), an http(s) address, or mailto.
editor.missing: Not offered by this forum right now — its extension may be disabled. It comes back if the extension does.
editor.not_a_link: This is a button, not a link, so it can stay in the menu or be hidden, but not go in the header.
editor.direct_help: How many header links are shown before the rest go behind the More menu. A narrow window shows fewer.
editor.logo_help: Optional. Leave empty to keep your theme's logo size. A smaller logo leaves more room for header links; on a phone it is held to 40 pixels.
editor.save_failed: The navigation could not be saved.
editor.reset_confirm: Go back to the starting navigation? Your changes here are not saved until you press Save.
